subject: Arts this weekend: Art School reception, Jenn Colella, YSO Halloween
text:
YALE ARTS WEEKLY

Yale School of Art undergraduate exhibition
Green Gallery, 1156 Chapel St, through Sun Nov 1 (M-F 12-6pm, Sa/Su 12-4pm). Reception Fri Oct 30, 6-8pm.

Jenn Colella master class + reception
The Tony nominee from "Come From Away." Fri Oct 30, 5:00-7:30pm, The Ballroom at 220 York St. Free, open to all.

YSO Halloween Show
Sat Oct 31 at Woolsey Hall. Pre-show by student band Flannel at 11:30pm, main show at midnight. Costumes encouraged.
